title: VP camp dismisses fresh cash suitcase claims as another 'tanim witness’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday dismissed as “another tanim witness” the allegations of a man identified only by the alias “Chris” that he had twice delivered suitcases of money to the vice president. In a statement, Duterte spokesperson Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr. denied the allegations and said that the vice president would dispute the claims with evidence at the proper time.
